title: Loans per genre
statementMd:
How many loans did each genre receive? Most popular first.

Expected columns: `genre`, `loans`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT b.genre, COUNT(*) AS loans FROM loans l JOIN books b ON b.id = l.book_id GROUP BY b.genre ORDER BY loans DESC;
```
